
DESCRIPTION
Create a workspace

USAGE
  one create [dir] [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one create demo
  one create .
  one create demo --yes

TIPS
Create an empty workspace named after its target folder. Empty directories and empty Git repositories are supported. Run one add afterward to add a project. Installs one-cli usage and find-skills discovery guidance in the workspace's .agents/skills by default; use --skip-skills to skip. Business skills are installed manually.

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
  --skip-skills            Skip automatic installation of workspace and technology-stack skills
  -y, --yes                Use defaults without prompting

AUTOMATION AND ADVANCED OPTIONS
  -n, --name <value>       Workspace name (default: target directory name)
